sources.name: GPT-6 Sol
sources.scope: API model identifier gpt-6-sol; reasoning.effort supports none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, and max. Does not establish client intelligence levels or account availability; gpt-6.1-sol is a separate model.

sources.name: GPT-6 model guidance
sources.scope: Current family guidance highlights GPT-6.1 Sol, not the pinned GPT-6 Sol. Prompting advice addresses behavior observed with Astra and requires evaluation on the selected Sol model and workload; it is not a Sol behavior measurement.

sources.name: AGENTS.md discovery
sources.scope: Startup discovery from CODEX_HOME and project root to CWD; override, AGENTS.md, then configured fallback priority, at most one file per directory, with deeper guidance taking precedence. Describes project_doc_max_bytes as a combined limit (default 32 KiB); Advanced Configuration uses different per-file wording, so actual client loading must be checked.

sources.name: Project instructions discovery (Advanced Configuration)
sources.scope: Describes project_doc_max_bytes as an amount read per AGENTS.md file, unlike the combined-limit wording in the AGENTS.md guide. Records this documentation discrepancy without asserting a uniform client implementation or equating the limit with the model context window.

sources.name: Subagents
sources.scope: Local Codex delegates on direct requests or applicable AGENTS.md/skill instructions; Work normally requires explicit requests, while eligible Ultra supports proactive delegation. Covers independent scopes, extra token use, default parent model/effort inheritance and configured overrides, and inherited sandbox/approval settings; read-only instructions do not create a separate sandbox. Does not establish API effort support for gpt-6-sol.
